understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the player through the tile grid to reach the goal gem (+), following the direction of gravity and avoiding hazards.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Horizontal MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT actions shifted the player and then caused automatic falling in the current gravity direction until landing or encountering an obstacle, hazard, or goal. CLICK removed clickable breakable blocks at the specified coordinates and could open new fall paths; clicks could also trigger immediate gravity movement. Spikes caused failure on contact, while support tiles were safe to land on. UNDO could revert the previous action and was useful for recovering from mistakes.
